data.name: Arkaansh
data.gender_notes: Arkaansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arkaansh is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Arka (Sun) and Ansh (Symbol or representation). This name is derived from the Sun God, symbolizing the radiance, power, and energy of the sun. The name Arkaansh carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arkaansh usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arkaansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
